ابتذلتما (form VIII)
# اِبْتَذَلْتُمَا (ibtaḏaltumā) /ib.ta.ðal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اُبْتُذِلْتُمَا (ubtuḏiltumā) /ub.tu.ðil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
